title: Quant Trading: Explained by a Jane Street Intern
reason: Jane Street 实习生视角：做市商与流动性是什么、量化研究和交易的分工、模拟交易，以及行业真实的工作强度（字幕只包含视频的前 8 分钟）。

notes.summary: 一位 Jane Street 实习生讲解做市商与量化的日常：Jane Street 通过双边报价提供流动性、赚取买卖价差；量化交易与量化研究的分工正在融合；实习以模拟交易为主；并坦率谈到工时长、竞争激烈等现实。（视频字幕被截断，只有前 8 分钟。）
keyPoints: 做市商（market maker）：同时挂买价和卖价（如 499 买 / 501 卖），赚取价差并为市场提供流动性。
流动性的意义：让人「买得进、卖得出」，如大豆农民依赖流动性才敢生产。
量化研究偏统计：用历史数据做检验、找显著规律；量化交易偏执行与决策；两者正在融合。
不同公司风格不同：Two Sigma 更偏自动化交易，Jane Street 既有交易机器人，也重视人工交易训练。
实习用模拟交易：安全、便宜，而且模拟市场规律更明显，利于训练直觉。
现实：量化交易岗位工时长（至少 40、常 50 小时/周）、强度高、竞争激烈。

glossary.def: 同时报出买价与卖价，为市场提供流动性并赚取价差的机构。
资产能以合理价格快速买入或卖出的容易程度。
卖价与买价之差，是做市商的主要利润来源。
用统计与历史数据寻找并检验交易规律。
把研究成果落实为交易决策与执行。
在仿真系统中练习交易，不涉及真实资金。

further: 搜索关键词：market microstructure（可接着看本站「市场微观结构」讲座）

transcript.text: I'm pretty sure like the average person would not only not know what a quant is but also they've probably never heard of Jane Street So the first thing I'll ask you is what exactly is Jane Street? How would you describe it to the average person? Yeah, sure So Jane Street is what we call a market making firm and it uses sort of like quantitative techniques to do that So what does a market maker write a market maker sort of like takes these stocks takes these like all these derivatives and whatever and just sort of like, you know, buys and sells them, right?
transcript.zh: （采访开场）普通人不仅不知道 quant 是什么，多半也没听过 Jane Street。Jane Street 是一家「做市商」（market maker）公司，用量化技术来做市：持有各种股票、衍生品，并不断买入卖出。

transcript.text: So maybe, right, maybe if you're trying to buy like some Tesla or something, right? Let's say Tesla's at $500. Let's say Jane Street might be buying at $499 and selling at $501, right? So by doing that, Jane Street will sort of like, you know, provide this service where like people can participate in the market, right? If you can buy and sell stocks, they can gain exposure into the sort of like, you know, the markets and the companies they believe in. If the markets are going like, if people are going to buy a lot of Tesla, it's still up to Jane Street to be able to provide both sides of the service.
transcript.zh: 例子：特斯拉报价 500 美元，Jane Street 可能以 499 买入、501 卖出。这样别人想买卖就总有对手方，可以参与他们看好的公司；即使大家都想买特斯拉，也要由做市商提供买卖双方的服务。

transcript.text: Right. And that's what provides liquidity in the market. I hear a lot about providing liquidity in the market from a market maker's perspective. So could you describe liquidity in a bit more detail? Yeah. So liquidity is sort of like a sort of like the crux of any like good free and open market. The idea being that like if I'm going to be comfortable trading, I can like again buy buy or sell stocks, derivatives, commodities, whatever you want. But if I'm going to feel comfortable, I need to feel like, hey, I should go to buy this and then sell it later on. If it's too hard to buy it or too hard to sell it, that's not going to make me feel good.
transcript.zh: 这就是为市场提供「流动性」（liquidity）。流动性是自由开放市场的核心：如果买了之后很难卖出（或想买时买不到），人们就不敢交易。

transcript.text: If I'm like a soybean farmer, this is a classic sort of example that we go through. If I'm like a soybean farmer, I depend on the liquidity of soybeans. If I have to grow myself soybeans, I have to sort of sell that off to purchase other goods and services for my living. If I can't sell my store, I'd be in trouble. I can reliably trust that I'll be able to sell it. But thanks to market makers like Jane Street who provide both sides sides of this buy they have this option that serves as this insurance Where it's like, oh, I know someone is going to be buying this, selling my soybeans. And because of that, I'm more comfortable engaging in that market and actually growing my soybeans.
transcript.zh: 经典例子：大豆农民要把大豆卖掉换取生活用品，他依赖大豆市场的流动性。有了 Jane Street 这样的做市商双边报价，他相信总有人买，就更放心地种大豆——做市商像一种「保险」。

transcript.text: So as a quant, what exactly do you do in this whole grand scheme of things? The goal name Maybe the game is sort of like, you know, currently something's sitting at a price. What is that price going to be in an hour? In maybe even in like a minute, maybe in 10 seconds, maybe in seven days, right? These sort of like, and so the idea of a plan is that your main goal is to either come up with, execute trading strategies, right? You provide the service liquidity by having buy sell, but at the same time, you're also able to pocket some of that difference, right?
transcript.zh: 量化研究员的角色：核心问题是——现在某个东西的价格，一小时后、一分钟后、10 秒后甚至 7 天后会是多少？目标是提出并执行交易策略：通过双边报价提供流动性，同时赚取一部分买卖价差。

transcript.text: You're able to be like, oh, I bought one for 499 and sold one for 501, oh, that's $2, great, I'm happy with that. Yeah. Or some will be like, oh, how do we execute this like perfectly? How do we, and you know, how do we make sure our systems can communicate with certain exchanges to get that going? Yeah. transcript.text: So what's the difference between the two roles at Jane Street? Yeah. Or just in general, I guess. Doing sort of like taking historical data and sort of like running tests, you know. You run these tests, right? And you're able to like, you know, you come up with patterns, right? Let's say, oh, there's some significance to these results, right? Right. And the idea is that maybe you do that and maybe someone goes in and tries to trade on that strategy, right?
transcript.zh: 两者区别：量化研究更偏统计——拿历史数据做检验，找出有显著性的规律；然后可能由交易员去交易这个策略。不同公司做法不同。

transcript.text: That's what a trader would do, right? A lot of different firms do it in different ways. So for example, Two Sigma, where you interned actually, focuses a lot more on sort of automatic trading or automated trading right Where they won have people like at each other who will sort of instead be like oh I try a bot to do it for me right Bots are much faster than us, and they can trade much higher volume, and if you can be confident in that strategy, then a bot can do much better than a human can.
transcript.zh: 例如 Two Sigma 更偏自动化交易：让机器人来做，因为机器人比人快得多、能处理更大的成交量；只要对策略有信心，机器人就比人做得好。

transcript.text: Jane Street focuses more on the human side. Of course, Jane Street still does have all these automated trading bots, but Jane Street will oftentimes also train manual trading. I remember we do a lot of mock trading sessions where we like physically go in with like something that looks like a system that like real Jane Street traders use And we'd actually practice with it. transcript.text: sort of like oh you know you've got to be you got to be the pinnacle of research and a lot of people are converting into automated trading and sort of the rules of being a quant trader and a quant researcher are sort of merging together, if that makes sense. transcript.text: Right. On the market, right? They'll just get money. So it's just mostly cost effective for firms to just, you know, come up with their own like little mock system. quiz.q: 做市商（market maker）的基本做法是？
options: 同时挂出买价和卖价，赚取价差并提供流动性
只交易衍生品，不交易股票

options: 大豆农民依赖能随时卖出大豆
quiz.explain: 有做市商保证总有人买，农民才敢放心生产大豆。

quiz.q: 以 499 买入、501 卖出，一个来回赚取的是？
